tickets.title: Home can be ordered by the model, with a short progress brief on top
tickets.what:
Settings offers a Home mode: Default (today's fixed order) or Recommended. In Recommended the
Decision API ranks the current cards by how much they matter to the owner now; Home puts the important ones first and
folds the unimportant settled ones. A one- or two-sentence brief at the top of Home says where the work stands (what
moved, what waits on the owner, what is next). Cards that need the owner are never folded or demoted. Without a key,
or when a call fails, Home falls back to Default silently.

Legacy Blocked by: None (can start immediately). Blocks 04 (the review covers it).

Brief at the top of Home, 1–2 sentences, refreshed with the ranking; never invents facts beyond the cards

No key / failure / models off → Default, no error text on Home
